story_generator.name: Story Generator
story_generator.notes: Music Studio: rhyme colours read inner rhymes per syllable (exact and near) and link a line end with a syllable in the next line; the pair details show EXACT / NEAR; new view 'live / dead syllables' (คำเป็น–คำตาย) in Rhyme & Syllables; the Python rhyme analysis gives near-only groups a letter; ผลัก is read as one syllable. Needs pythainlp 5.4.0 or newer (5.3.x misreads some vowels). 0.3.2: Analyze Song uses a Python rhyme analysis and refuses malformed AI output; Basic caption builder; app-wide font size; Ctrl+click several AI Recommend style cards.
